Reactivation
The SPDA is hereby reactivated
effective immediately.
It shall have a lean and professional organization,
shall be under the oversight of the Office of the Presidential Adviser on the Peace
Process (OPAPP).
.

of the Board-
The Board shall have, among
others, the following functions:
a. Approve policies and implementing
guidelines needed to accomplish
the purpose and objectives of SPDA;
b. Determine and approve the organizational structure, staffing pattern
and pay scales of SPDA, its officers and employees subject to existing
rules and regulations;
.
